lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Lease liabilities
lines.why: IFRS 16 puts every lease on the balance sheet like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Provisions
lines.why: Obligations of uncertain timing or amount (warranties, restructuring, legal claims): operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: In 2025 and 2024, our immunoglobulin products accounted for approximately 54.3% and 50.8% of our net revenue, respectively.
The Biopharma business unit accounted for €6.5 billion, or 86.2%, of our total net revenue in 2025.
The Diagnostic business unit accounted for €640 million, or 8.5%, of our total net revenue in 2025.
The Bio Supplies business unit accounted for €154 million, or 2.0%, of our total net revenue in 2025.
Others accounted for €243 million, or 3.2%, of our total net revenue in 2025.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, the United States and Canada accounted for 56.5% of our total net revenue, the European Union accounted for 21.5% of our total net revenues (25.9% of which was generated in Spain) and the rest of the world accounted for 22.0% of our total net revenue.
In 2025, the Biopharma business unit accounted for 86.2% of our total net revenue.
In 2025, sales of Albutein 25% and 5% FlexBag in the United States represented 19.0% of the total Albutein brand sales (as compared to 15.0% in 2024).

The Diagnostic business unit, which accounted for €640 million, or 8.5% of total net revenue in 2025, focuses on researching, developing, manufacturing and marketing in vitro diagnostics products, including analytical instruments, reagents, software and associated products for use in diagnostic clinical and blood bank laboratories.
The Healthcare Solutions business accounted for €138 million, or 1.8%, of our total net revenue in 2025.

Our immunoglobulin franchise (one of our main proteins representing approximately 63.0% of the Biopharma business units’ revenue) recorded a revenue increase of 11.5% (14.7% at constant currency) in 2025 in comparison to 2024, driven by strong demand in key international markets, particularly the U.S. Subcutaneous immunoglobulin (SCIG) stood out with a revenue growth of 55.4% (59.5% at constant currency), gaining market share and increasing penetration in the United States.

In 2024, there was an increase in sales of immunoglobulins (one of our main proteins representing approximately 60% of the Biopharma business units’ revenue), the net revenue of which grew by 14.5% (15.3% at constant currency) fueled by strong demand for intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) and subcutaneous immunoglobulin (SCIG) Xembify, with SCIG reporting an increase of 15.3% (55.5% at constant currency).
In 2025, 21.5% of our sales were generated in the European Union, as compared to 21.4% in 2024 and 19.1% in 2023.
In 2025 and 2024 there is no customer that represents more than 10 % of the Group’s gross revenue.
In 2023, a customer in the Biopharma segment represents approximately the 10.37 % of the Group’s gross revenue.
You should not rely on the market share and other market information presented herein as precise measures of market share or of other actual conditions.
Our ability to make these payments depends on our future performance, which will be affected by financial, business, economic and other factors, many of which could be beyond our control.
Our ability to generate cash depends on many factors, some of which may be beyond our control.
Our ability to make payments on and to refinance our indebtedness and to fund working capital needs and planned capital expenditures will depend on our ability to generate cash in the future.

The impact of any changes in laws regarding tariffs on our business, if any, will depend on the specific restrictions imposed on trade, including the effective date and duration of such tariffs, jurisdictions covered in such tariffs, amounts of such tariffs, and potential retaliatory tariffs imposed by other jurisdictions.
Our ability to continue manufacturing and distributing our products depends on our continued adherence to cGMP regulations at our facilities.
The majority of our revenue depends on our access to U.S. source plasma (obtained through plasmapheresis), the principal raw material for our plasma derivative products.
Our current business plan envisages an increase in the production of plasma derivative products, which depends on our ability to maintain and/or increase plasma collections or improve product yield.
Our ability to continue to produce safe and effective plasma derivative products depends on a plasma supply free of transmittable diseases.
Our future success depends on our ability to retain members of our senior management and to attract, retain and motivate qualified personnel.
Our plasma collection centers rely on disposable goods supplied by third parties and information technology systems hosted by third parties.

Our inability to obtain our key source supplies for the collection of plasma and manufacture of products may require us to delay shipments of products, harm customer relationships and force us to curtail operations.
We rely on the services of third parties for the manufacture of certain products.
However, for many of these products we rely upon supply from third parties.
The degree of market acceptance of our product candidates, if approved for commercial sale, will depend on a number of factors, some of which are beyond our control, including the following:

Our early-stage pipeline development, M&A activities, digital transformation initiatives, AI scaling ambitions, and end-to-end supply chain all depend on cross-border data flows now subject to increasing restrictions.
In addition to patented technology, we rely on our unpatented proprietary technology, trade secrets, processes and know-how.
We also rely on contractual protections with our customers, suppliers, distributors, employees and consultants and implement security measures designed to protect our trade secrets.

Since we rely on trade secrets and nondisclosure agreements, in addition to patents, to protect some of our intellectual property, there is a risk that third parties may obtain and improperly utilize our proprietary information to our competitive disadvantage.

Our rights in certain intellectual property that we have in-licensed or co-own with third parties and the value therein may depend on our third party licensors’ or co-owners’, as applicable, performance under our intellectual property agreements with them.
For example, some of our production facilities that depend on the availability of significant water supplies are located in areas where water is increasingly scarce.

The extent to which a biosimilar product, once approved, will be substituted for any of our products, in a way that is similar to traditional generic substitution for non-biological products is not yet clear, and will depend on a number of marketplace and regulatory factors that are still developing.

Also, in some countries we may rely on third parties for the marketing and distribution of our products, and these parties may lack sufficient internal compliance resources, and may operate in foreign markets involving substantial corruption.

This business unit includes, in addition, pharmaceutical products manufactured by the Group and intended for hospital pharmacies, as well as the marketing of products that complement our own products.
In several countries, we distribute BLOODchip blood group genotyping tests manufactured by our subsidiary Progenika Biopharma, S.A. (“Progenika”).
